(A) [0.8485, 0.3298, 0.9779, 0.4592]
(B) [0.8485, 0.5040, 0.9779, 0.6334]
(C) [0.8485, 0.1556, 0.9779, 0.2850]
(D) No UI element changed — the screenshots differ only in compression noise.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
